title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Strengthening the Implementation of Laws by People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the  
"Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening the Implementation of Laws by People's Courts"

Fa Fa [2011] No. 11

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Supreme People's Court's "Opinions on Strengthening the Implementation of Laws by People's Courts" are hereby issued for your earnest implementation in light of actual work.

August 1, 2011

Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening the Implementation of Laws by People's Courts

By the end of 2010, the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics was established as scheduled. To adapt to the new circumstances, new tasks, and new requirements faced by the people's courts after the formation of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, to correctly perform the sacred duties conferred by the Constitution and laws, and to effectively safeguard the dignity of the Constitution and laws, the following opinions are hereby put forward concerning the strengthening of law implementation by people's courts.

I. Profoundly Understand the Great Significance of Strengthening Law Implementation

The formation of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics is a historic achievement in China's socialist democratic legal construction over the past 60-plus years since the founding of New China, especially over the past 30-plus years of reform and opening up. It is a great accomplishment of the Communist Party of China leading the people of all ethnic groups across the country, based on China's actual conditions, to creatively advance the grand cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. It is also an important symbol of the comprehensive implementation of the fundamental strategy of governing the country according to law. It is of great practical significance and profound historical significance for building a modern socialist country that is prosperous, strong, democratic, culturally advanced, and harmonious, for achieving long-term stability and security of the country, and for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

The formation of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics has laid a solid legal foundation for the development of the people's judicial cause, provided a powerful legal guarantee for building a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system, and provided clear legal basis for the people's courts to adjudicate various types of cases fairly and efficiently. After the formation of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, the issue of having laws to follow has been generally resolved, while the requirements of ensuring that laws are observed, strictly enforced, and lawbreakers are prosecuted, and further strengthening law implementation, will become more prominent and urgent. The tasks of the people's courts in performing their duties according to law, safeguarding economic and social development, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the people, maintaining the unity of the legal system, and defending the dignity of the law will become heavier, and their responsibilities will become greater.

II. Correctly Grasp the General Requirements and Basic Principles for Strengthening Law Implementation

(1) To strengthen law implementation, we must hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents," thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to the guiding ideology of "the Party's cause is paramount, the people's interests are paramount, the Constitution and laws are paramount" and the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," firmly establish the socialist rule of law concept and trial concept, in accordance with the requirements of comprehensively implementing the fundamental strategy of governing the country according to law and accelerating the construction of a socialist country under the rule of law, strengthen legal awareness, improve judicial capability, focus on the primary task of handling cases, strengthen team building, promote judicial reform, give full play to the functions of adjudication and enforcement, effectively safeguard social fairness and justice, and provide strong judicial guarantees for promoting stable and rapid economic development and social harmony and stability, and for winning new victories in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects.

(2) To strengthen law implementation, we must correctly understand the basic national conditions at the current stage of our country and the essential laws of socialist rule of law construction with Chinese characteristics. Adhere to the organic unity of the Party's leadership, the people being the masters of the country, and governing the country according to law; comprehensively and accurately grasp the spiritual essence of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics; deeply comprehend the political nature, people's nature, scientific nature, and openness of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics; always maintain the correct direction of the work of the people's courts; effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the broad masses of the people; effectively guarantee the implementation of laws; promote the improvement of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics; and promote the construction of a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system.

(3) The people's courts must adhere to the following basic principles in strengthening law implementation:

——Adhere to impartial justice and safeguard the authority of the Constitution and laws. Be loyal to the Constitution and laws, take the lead in abiding by the Constitution and laws, and maintain the unity and dignity of the national legal system; adhere to taking facts as the basis and law as the criterion, strictly scrutinize the facts, evidence, procedures, and application of law in cases, and give equal weight to substantive justice and procedural justice; unify the standards of law enforcement, ensure the uniform application of laws, allow no privileges above the law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of the parties equally according to law, and achieve equality before the law.

——Adhere to clean justice and maintain the judicial image and credibility. In accordance with the requirement of "strictly governing the courts," actively cultivate a culture of judicial integrity, strictly implement disciplines and measures such as the "five prohibitions," judicial inspections, and the system of integrity supervisors, strengthen anti-corruption construction, effectively ensure that warning education and supervision management are in place, continuously enhance the awareness of anti-corruption, improve the ability to resist corruption and prevent degeneration, and maintain judicial integrity.

——Adhere to justice for the people and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the people. Adhere to the people-oriented principle, respect and protect human rights, and always pay close attention to the judicial needs of the people; adhere to the combination of mass viewpoint, mass stance, mass methods, and adjudication according to law, be good at listening to appeals with attitudes recognized by the masses, ascertaining facts in ways acceptable to the masses, interpreting legal principles in language understood by the masses, and resolving disputes in ways trusted by the masses, and strive to realize, safeguard, and develop the fundamental interests of the broadest masses of the people.

——Adhere to active justice and serve the overall work of the Party and the state. Based on adjudication and enforcement work, effectively implement the major strategic deployments of the Party and the state, focus on the theme of scientific development and the main line of accelerating the transformation of the economic development mode, cooperate with the national strategic adjustment of the economic structure, deeply implement the "three key tasks," deeply practice service-oriented, active, and efficient justice, and provide strong judicial guarantees for economic and social development.

III. Conscientiously Perform the Duties of Adjudication and Enforcement Conferred by the Constitution and Laws

(4) Regulate case-filing work, effectively solve the difficulty in filing lawsuits. File cases strictly according to law to guarantee the realization of the parties' right of action; regulate the order of litigation jurisdiction, promote the improvement of the system of elevating jurisdiction and designating jurisdiction; strengthen mediation during case filing, promote remote case filing to reduce the litigation burden on the parties; smooth the channels for appeals and applications for retrial, protect the parties' right to appeal and apply for retrial according to law; strengthen the mass viewpoint, adhere to source governance, establish long-term mechanisms, insist on shifting the focus of work downward, establish and improve the petition work mechanisms involving litigation, such as petition risk assessment, petition notification, diversified resolution, reception and handling, and petition closure, to improve the ability to handle petitions according to law; establish and supplement funds for legal aid in cases involving litigation and petitions, improve the aid system, and promote the cessation of petitions.

(5) Strengthen criminal adjudication work, correctly implement criminal laws. Deeply implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, so as to both effectively crack down on and deter crimes, maintain the seriousness of the legal system, and minimize social confrontation, turning negative factors into positive ones; do a good job in the trial and approval of death penalty cases, strictly control and cautiously apply the death penalty; strictly implement criminal evidence rules to ensure that no innocent person is prosecuted; comprehensively promote the reform of sentencing standardization, unify the application of law, and achieve sentencing balance; strengthen mediation in private prosecution cases and criminal附带 civil litigation cases, promote criminal reconciliation; implement the relief work for victims of crimes to effectively resolve social conflicts; reform and improve the commutation and parole work to ensure the effective realization of the purpose of punishment; strengthen the adjudication of juvenile crimes to fully reflect the state's special judicial protection for minors; actively participate in community correction work to ensure the full function of non-custodial penalties; actively participate in comprehensive management of public security, support and cooperate with relevant departments in building a public security prevention and control system and carrying out activities to create a safe environment, promote the improvement of the public security system, prevent and reduce crimes, and maintain social order.

(6) Strengthen civil and commercial adjudication work, correctly implement civil and commercial laws. Accurately grasp the national economic situation and policies, handle civil and commercial cases properly according to law to promote stable and rapid economic development; equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, punish acts of breach of contract and infringement according to law, maintain social integrity and market order; increase mediation efforts to effectively resolve social disputes, promote family harmony and social harmony; regulate the discretionary power of judges according to law to ensure the organic unity of legal effect and social effect in handling cases; appropriately simplify litigation procedures, actively explore small-claims expedited procedures; improve litigation services, increase judicial aid, facilitate litigation for the parties, and improve litigation efficiency.

(7) Strengthen administrative adjudication work, ensure the correct implementation of administrative laws. Effectively strengthen the protection of the right to administrative litigation, accept administrative litigation cases according to law, and smooth the channels for administrative litigation relief; earnestly implement the principle of legality review, support and supervise administrative organs in administering according to law, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts; increase coordination efforts in administrative litigation cases and non-litigation administrative enforcement cases; standardize the standards and procedures for judicial review of administrative acts, strengthen the analysis of administrative adjudication situations and information feedback, and promote the establishment of a law-based government; strengthen the work of judicial suggestions in administrative adjudication to promote the improvement of public policies.

(8) Strengthen state compensation work, correctly implement the State Compensation Law. Adhere to seeking truth from facts, correcting errors according to law, and compensating according to law, effectively implement the state's compensation liability, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of compensation claimants; standardize the trial procedures of state compensation cases, improve the legal aid system for state compensation, and promote consultation and settlement; improve the system for recovering and pursuing accountability to promote fair and honest law enforcement.

(9) Strengthen enforcement work, effectively uphold the dignity of the law. Adhere to enforcement according to law and civilized enforcement; deepen enforcement reform, rely on political and institutional advantages, give full play to the role of the enforcement coordination mechanism, and build a pattern of comprehensive governance to solve enforcement difficulties; regulate enforcement behavior, strengthen the separation of powers and checks, promote enforcement transparency, improve systems such as objections by third parties, enforcement objections, and review of reconsideration, promote the improvement of civil enforcement legislation, and provide legal guarantees for solving enforcement difficulties; promote the informatization of enforcement work, improve the information management system for enforcement cases, and continuously improve the level of enforcement work.

(10) Strengthen trial supervision work, adhere to correcting errors according to law. Strengthen trial supervision over criminal cases, promptly correct wrongful convictions and unjust cases; strengthen trial supervision over civil, commercial, and administrative cases, protect the parties' right to apply for retrial according to law; increase mediation efforts in retrial cases, actively explore different ways to correct errors according to law, strive to prevent errors through correction, promote management through correction, and promote integrity through correction, and give full play to the important role of trial supervision in resolving contradictions and promoting social harmony; improve the working mechanisms for the review of retrial applications and retrial trials in civil and administrative cases, and standardize the relationship between internal and superior-inferior courts in terms of supervision, restriction, and professional guidance according to law to ensure the correct implementation of laws.

(11) Strengthen mediation work, effectively implement the working principle of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication." Adhere to the principle of voluntary and lawful mediation, correctly handle the relationship between mediation and adjudication, and ensure the effectiveness of mediation work; adhere to comprehensive, full-staff, and full-procedure mediation, expand the scope of cases suitable for mediation according to law, continuously innovate mediation methods, and increase mediation efforts; improve the mediation system, regulate mediation activities, enhance mediation capabilities, and raise the level of mediation work; do a good job in judicial confirmation of people's mediation agreements according to law, improve the mechanism for linking litigation and mediation, actively promote the construction of a "grand mediation" system, make full use of social resources, work together to resolve social contradictions, and make every effort to promote social harmony.

(12) Strengthen judicial interpretation, unify the application of laws. Adapt to the needs of trial work, formulate judicial interpretations in a timely manner; accurately grasp the spirit of the law, exercise the power of judicial interpretation prudently according to law; strictly implement the system of reporting judicial interpretations to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for record, carefully carry out the work in the formulation of judicial interpretations, including project initiation, drafting, review, solicitation of opinions, discussion, and publication, timely clean up and compile judicial interpretations, maintain the coherence and timeliness of judicial interpretations, strengthen the scientific and standardized management of the formulation of judicial interpretations, and continuously improve the level of judicial interpretation work.

(13) Strengthen case guidance, unify adjudication standards. Give full play to the important role of guiding cases in guiding trials, publicizing the legal system, and preventing disputes, promote fair and unified justice, and strive to enhance judicial credibility and authority; innovate and improve the ways of professional guidance in trials, deeply study and promptly summarize advanced judicial concepts, fair adjudication rules, and scientific adjudication methods, unify judicial concepts and adjudication standards, improve judges' judicial ability to use cases, and achieve the organic unity of legal effect and social effect in adjudicating cases.

IV. Continuously Improve the Working Mechanisms for Strengthening Law Implementation

(14) Promote judicial democracy, guarantee people's participation in justice. Improve the mechanism for communicating and expressing public opinion, improve the liaison mechanism with deputies to the People's Congress and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), build a dialogue platform between the people's courts and the masses, lawyers, experts, and scholars, further improve the people's juror system, strengthen the construction of the system of specially invited advisors to the people's courts, and effectively guarantee the parties and all sectors of society the right to know, participate, express, and supervise the activities of law implementation.

(15) Promote judicial openness, implement "sunshine justice." Further implement the principle of open trials, establish and improve rules for attending and reporting trials that are orderly open and effectively managed, further promote the online publication of judgments, improve the method of accessing litigation files, gradually realize electronic file review, establish and improve websites and other information disclosure platforms, promote the system of white papers on trial work and annual work reports of the people's courts, continuously expand the breadth and depth of judicial openness, and continuously improve the institutional mechanisms for judicial openness.

(16) Improve litigation convenience mechanisms, facilitate the masses in litigation. By establishing case-filing reception halls, litigation service centers, promoting online case-filing, and remote case-filing experiences, expand litigation service functions, explore the establishment of information-based courtrooms, carry out measures such as scheduled trials, circuit trials, and litigation guidance, continuously meet the needs of the masses to conveniently and quickly participate in litigation activities and enjoy high-quality and efficient legal services; expand the scope of application of summary procedures according to law, continuously increase the use of summary procedures in adjudicating cases, further standardize the application of summary procedures, realize the diversion of complex and simple cases, truly give full play to the timely, simple, and rapid institutional functions of civil summary procedures, improve trial efficiency, reduce litigation costs for the parties, so that the parties can be freed from litigation as soon as possible, and reduce the litigation burden on the masses.

(17) Improve the trial management system, improve trial quality and efficiency. Follow the laws governing the operation of adjudicative power, strengthen trial management according to law, ensure that trial activities are conducted openly, fairly, efficiently, and orderly in strict accordance with legal procedures; establish and improve systems such as trial quality management, trial efficiency management, trial process management, and trial performance assessment, achieve standardized trial management; give full play to the "baton" role of the case quality assessment indicator system, achieve scientific and refined trial management.

(18) Strengthen court administrative management, improve judicial guarantee working mechanisms. Further implement the court construction policy of "strictly governing the courts, establishing credibility through justice, and strengthening the courts through science and technology," strengthen the management work of the courts, and continuously improve the level of court management and judicial decision-making; strengthen the administrative management of the people's courts, continuously enhance comprehensive coordination capabilities, and further improve the quality and efficiency of administrative management; accelerate the material equipment management and informatization construction of the people's courts, achieve standardization and informatization of trial courtrooms, basic-level people's court infrastructure, and material equipment; continuously improve the level of guarantee and management of judicial funds, and lay a solid foundation for the people's courts to perform their functions of law implementation.

(19) Strengthen judicial capacity building, continuously improve the quality of the team. Attach great importance to the Party building and ideological and political construction of the people's courts, earnestly implement the overall work idea of "grasping Party building to lead team building and promote adjudication," actively practice the core judicial values of "fairness, integrity, and serving the people," firm up ideals and beliefs, and clarify value pursuits; strengthen the scientific and standardized management of judges, explore the establishment of a court personnel management system that is both in line with the characteristics of judicial work and the laws of personnel management; strengthen judge training, improve judicial capability, focus on improving judges' ability to correctly apply the law and do mass work; promote the construction of judicial work style and judicial integrity, inherit the fine traditions of people's justice, strictly abide by professional ethics and codes of conduct for judges, establish and improve a long-term mechanism for anti-corruption, and continuously improve the judicial image and credibility of the people's court team; promote court culture construction, strengthen the shaping of court cultural image in trial and office premises, and create a healthy, positive, and distinctive court cultural atmosphere; promote the protection of the judge profession, implement the professional treatment of judges, and enhance the sense of professional honor of judges; attach importance to the construction of the team of basic-level judges, adhere to the policy of shifting the focus downward, and tilt towards basic-level, western, and ethnic minority areas as much as possible in terms of work guidance, staffing, and judicial guarantees, and effectively help solve practical difficulties and problems such as the shortage of judges and insufficient funding.

(20) Promote judicial reform, establish and improve mechanisms. Adhere to the principles of judicial reform of "grasping the direction, based on national conditions, advancing according to law, and ensuring fairness," pay attention to carrying forward the fine traditions of people's justice, scientifically learn from foreign judicial experience, and actively explore new ideas, new measures, and new mechanisms to achieve fair, efficient, and authoritative justice; conscientiously implement the Central Committee's opinions on promoting the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms, improve mechanisms, strengthen guidance, and focus on solving the institutional and mechanistic obstacles affecting the correct implementation of laws after the formation of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics; fully complete the tasks of the reform, and ensure the implementation of the reform plans that have been issued; deeply carry out theoretical research and empirical investigation on judicial reform, carefully summarize and promptly promote the experience and practices of courts at all levels in advancing judicial reform, promptly discover problems in the reform practice, and put forward suggestions for deepening reform.

(21) Consciously accept supervision, strive for support and cooperation. Consciously accept the work supervision of the People's Congresses at all levels and their standing committees, the democratic supervision of the CPPCC, the legal supervision of the procuratorial organs, and the supervision of all sectors of society, strive for the support and guarantee of the government and other relevant departments, strengthen communication, coordination, and cooperation with other judicial organs, firmly rely on the broad masses of the people, and strive to create a good atmosphere in which the whole society cares about justice, supports justice, respects justice, and trusts justice.

(22) Improve the working mechanism for judicial suggestions, strengthen and innovate social management. For problems found in social management during trials, enforcement, petitions, and other work, promptly put forward judicial suggestions to the government or relevant departments, pay attention to collecting and organizing feedback, and transform them into important bases for the people's courts to formulate judicial policies and judicial interpretations; vigorously strengthen basic-level work, through establishing harmonious co-construction relationships with various types of basic-level organizations, establish and improve the prevention mechanism for disputes, the resolution mechanism for disputes, and the mass work mechanism, promote the improvement of basic-level social management and the effective resolution of social disputes.

(23) Strengthen the publicity of the rule of law and promote the spirit of the rule of law. Through fair, efficient, and honest adjudication and enforcement work, timely and effectively resolve social conflicts, fully leverage the function of publicity and education on the rule of law, cultivate the legal awareness and rule of law literacy of the people, educate citizens and social organizations to express demands and resolve disputes in accordance with the law, habitually use legal means to protect their own legitimate rights and interests, promote the rule of law to become the spirit of the times and the belief of the entire people, and make voluntary compliance with the law a mode of conduct for all citizens.

(24) Strengthen learning and research, and continuously improve the ability to implement the law. Adapt to the new requirements and high standards for judges' judicial capabilities arising from the formation of the socialist legal system with Chinese characteristics, comprehensively and systematically strengthen the study and training of legal theory, the Constitution, and laws and regulations, vigorously promote the building of learning-oriented courts and learning-oriented judges, place greater emphasis on grasping the spirit and core values of the law, place greater emphasis on innovation in trial theory, focus on the integration of theory and practice, place greater emphasis on summarizing experience in the application of law, innovate methods of applying law, and make good and flexible use of judicial statistical data; strive to explore and follow the patterns of judicial work, promote the timely improvement of legislation, more effectively serve the scientific development of the economy and society, and achieve the scientific development of the people's courts themselves.
